description: Use when writing physics or numerical simulations — choosing an integrator (RK4, symplectic, semi-Lagrangian, split-step), validating against analytic solutions and conserved quantities, unit tests with tolerances, reproducible plots and animations for documentation, and interactive toys that stay physically honest. Also use when energy drifts, results depend on the time step, a simulation explodes, or a demo looks right but numbers disagree with theory.
